question: _________ is an Indian regional political party in the state of Tamil Nadu and the union territory of Puducherry, established in 1972.
solution:
The correct answer is __**AIADMK**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AIADMK** (All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam) is a regional political party in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu and the union territory of Puducherry.
 
• The party was established in 1972 by M.G. Ramachandran, a popular actor and politician in Tamil Nadu.
 
• AIADMK has been a significant player in Tamil Nadu politics and has formed the state government multiple times.
 
• The party's symbol is "Two Leaves" and it has a strong base among the rural and urban population in Tamil Nadu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **AIADMK** has been known for its welfare schemes and populist measures aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of the people in Tamil Nadu.
 
• The party has faced several internal splits and leadership challenges, especially after the demise of its prominent leaders.
 
• AIADMK has also played a crucial role in national politics, often aligning with major national parties to form coalition governments.
 
• The party's influence extends to cultural and social spheres, with strong ties to the Tamil film industry.
 
• AIADMK's rival party in Tamil Nadu is the DMK (Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam), and the political landscape of the state is often dominated by the contest between these two major parties.
